notes: Wordplay batch: accents/apostrophes mostly matter in the word-origin themes. hidden birds/insects are real animals, so not separate from hidden animals; silent k/b/w are silent-letter words, so not separate. Flagged tit and boob in palindromes as adult. Familiarity follows the batch's existing scale (1 = most readily known). Wordplay themes depending on spelling (hidden words, letter play) left letter-for-letter unchanged; homographs keeps 'resume' (verb vs plain-letter résumé).
